line.en: dublin's big festive fair at the rds, open 14:00 to 21:00 on weekdays and from noon at weekends, shut on mondays, until 3 january. go straight after work.
line.de: dublins großes winterfest im rds, werktags 14 bis 21 uhr, am wochenende ab 12 uhr, montags geschlossen, bis 3. januar. am besten direkt nach der arbeit.
line.tr: dublin'in büyük kış festivali rds'te; hafta içi 14:00 ile 21:00, hafta sonu öğlen 12'den itibaren, pazartesi kapalı, 3 ocak'a kadar. işten çıkınca git.

sparks.why: Everwinter at the RDS, 25 Nov 2026 to 3 Jan 2027, Tue to Fri 14:00 to 21:00, weekends from noon, closed Mondays (theirishroadtrip.com Christmas markets guide). Extra.ie headline of 11 Nov says it has arrived, so the start date is unsettled.
